links.outcome: Answer changes when demographic prefixes added to identical vignettes versus no-demographic baseline
links.effect: 1,097 of 5,400 demographic comparisons changed the answer (20.3%); MedGemma 27B had the lowest change rate (16.0%), OpenBioLLM the highest.
links.quote: Across 5,400 demographic comparisons, 1,097 answers were changed (20.3%).

links.outcome: Stereotype evidence flags in model explanations under demographic prefixes, judged automatically
links.effect: 3,128 stereotype evidence flags, including 1,932 in the broad Other category; GLM had the highest stereotype flag rate.
links.quote: Automated judging identified 3,128 stereotype evidence flags, including 1,932 in the broad Other category.

unlisted_practices: Counterfactual validity testing of LLMs (asking model to make a minimal clinical change that alters the correct answer)
Explanation Demographic Dissonance (EDD) metric for explanation-level bias

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study testing the counterfactual validity and demographic robustness/bias of multiple LLMs on MedQA USMLE questions using automated perturbation tests.
